title: Northern Virginia Private Custom Wine Tour and Tasting from DC
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

blurb:
Please note:
This tour doesn't include admission for the Wineries. Price is for a 6 hour SUV transfer, additional fees will be charged if the tour exceeds 6 hours. 
This is a completely customizable private wine tour. The locations that are shown are just a sample. If you prefer to visit your desired wineries please let us know so we can customize your 6-hour tour accordingly.

868 Estate Vineyards and Breaux Vineyards
